title: Ruth and Boaz

questions.question: What did Naomi tell Ruth to do at the threshing floor?
options: Uncover Boaz’s feet and lie down
questions.correctAnswer: Uncover Boaz’s feet and lie down
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:4 (ESV): “...when he lies down... go and uncover his feet and lie down, and he will tell you what to do.”

questions.question: What did Boaz call Ruth when she lay at his feet?
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:10–11 (ESV): “And he said, ‘...my daughter. Do not fear. I will do for you all that you ask...’”

questions.question: What did Ruth ask Boaz to do?
options: Spread his wings over her as redeemer
questions.correctAnswer: Spread his wings over her as redeemer
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:9 (ESV): “...‘Spread your wings over your servant, for you are a redeemer.’”

questions.question: Why couldn’t Boaz redeem Ruth immediately?
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:12 (ESV): “And now it is true that I am a redeemer. Yet there is a redeemer nearer than I.”

questions.question: What did Boaz give Ruth before she left?
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:15 (ESV): “And he said, ‘Bring the garment you are wearing...’ And he measured out six measures of barley and put it on her.”

questions.question: What was Boaz doing at the threshing floor?
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:2 (ESV): "...Behold, he is winnowing barley tonight at the threshing floor."

questions.question: What preparations did Naomi tell Ruth to make?
options: Wash, anoint yourself, and put on your cloak
questions.correctAnswer: Wash, anoint yourself, and put on your cloak
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:3 (ESV): "Wash therefore and anoint yourself, and put on your cloak and go down to the threshing floor..."

questions.question: At what time did Boaz wake up and realize a woman was at his feet?
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:8 (ESV): "At midnight the man was startled and turned over, and behold, a woman lay at his feet!"

questions.question: How did Boaz describe Ruth to his fellow townsmen?
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:11 (ESV): "...for all my fellow townsmen know that you are a worthy woman."

questions.question: When did Ruth leave the threshing floor?
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:14 (ESV): "So she lay at his feet until the morning, but arose before one could recognize another..."

questions.question: What reason did Boaz give for Ruth asking him to redeem her?
options: You have made this last kindness greater than the first
questions.correctAnswer: You have made this last kindness greater than the first
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:10 (ESV): "...You have made this last kindness greater than the first in that you have not gone after young men..."

questions.question: Why did Boaz tell Ruth to bring her cloak?
options: To hold the barley he gave her
questions.correctAnswer: To hold the barley he gave her
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:15 (ESV): "And he said, 'Bring the garment you are wearing and hold it out.' So she held it..."

questions.question: What did Naomi ask Ruth when she returned?
options: How did you fare, my daughter? (Who are you?)
questions.correctAnswer: How did you fare, my daughter? (Who are you?)
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:16 (ESV): "And when she came to her mother-in-law, she said, 'How did you fare, my daughter?'" (ESV Footnote: Lit. Who are you, my daughter?)

questions.question: Naomi said the man will not rest until what?
options: He has settled the matter this day
questions.correctAnswer: He has settled the matter this day
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:18 (ESV): "...for the man will not rest but will settle the matter today."

questions.question: What did Boaz specifically want to avoid people knowing?
options: That the woman came to the threshing floor
questions.correctAnswer: That the woman came to the threshing floor
questions.explanation: Ruth 3:14 (ESV): "...And he said, 'Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.'"

key_verse_text: “And now, my daughter, do not fear. I will do for you all that you ask, for all my fellow townsmen know that you are a worthy woman.” (ESV)
